method_scopes.rationale: The single assigned target is Hou 2016 scTrio-seq. All encoded operations apply to this implementation. The diagram inventory consists of isolation, lysis/centrifugation, an RNA route (RNA addition, oligo hybridization, cDNA synthesis, TDT tailing, PCR/sequencing), a lower nuclear DNA route (MspI digestion, methylated-adapter reagent, end repair/ligation, bisulfite conversion, PCR/sequencing), and alignment. The drawn independent middle DNA adapter/PCR route is superseded by the paper-supported shared scRRBS origin of CNV and methylation data (c_shared_rrbs). Read interpretation is represented at the level needed to explain these two outputs. scRRBS is a component of scTrio-seq, not an extra target method. Other poster rows, scTrio-seq2, surrounding chemical drawings, related assays and catalogue-associated kits are excluded from the declared target. The normal-liver reference input is scoped to the paper's human CNV example and is not prescribed for every mammalian specimen.
